easy: A unit for measuring how long something is. Twelve of them make one foot.

ex.en: The sign said the box was 12 in. wide.
ex.ko: 표지판에는 상자 폭이 12인치라고 쓰여 있었다.

easy: Into a place, or toward the inside of it.

ex.en: Come in, the cookies are ready!
ex.ko: 들어와, 쿠키 다 됐어!

easy: The work of using computers and networks to keep and send information.

ex.en: My uncle works in IT and fixes computers at a big company.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 IT 분야에서 일하시고 큰 회사의 컴퓨터를 고치신다.

easy: Forward, moving ahead without stopping.

ex.en: We walked on until we reached the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 호수에 닿을 때까지 계속 걸었다.

easy: Continuing; not stopping.

ex.en: The band played on even when it started to rain.
ex.ko: 비가 오기 시작했는데도 밴드는 계속 연주했다.

easy: Working or running, like a light that has been switched to work.

ex.en: Dad left the TV on all night.
ex.ko: 아빠가 밤새 TV를 켜 두셨다.

easy: A word that turns a sentence into its opposite, meaning 'no'.

ex.en: My cat does not like baths.
ex.ko: 우리 고양이는 목욕을 좋아하지 않는다.

easy: A room in a hospital where doctors do operations.

ex.en: The doctors rushed the patient into the OR.
ex.ko: 의사들은 환자를 급히 수술실로 옮겼다.

easy: Just a single thing, not two or more.

ex.en: I have only one dog.
ex.ko: 나는 강아지가 딱 한 마리 있다.

easy: A metal container that is sealed shut to keep food or drink fresh.

ex.en: We opened a can of soup for lunch.
ex.ko: 우리는 점심으로 수프 한 캔을 땄다.

easy: The amount that fits inside a can.

ex.en: The hungry puppy ate a whole can of food.
ex.ko: 배고픈 강아지가 사료 한 캔을 다 먹었다.

easy: To seal food in a can or jar so it stays good for a long time.

ex.en: Grandma cans peaches every summer.
ex.ko: 할머니는 여름마다 복숭아 통조림을 만드신다.

easy: A bigger amount of something.

ex.en: Can I have more juice, please?
ex.ko: 주스 좀 더 주실래요?

easy: A bigger number of things.

ex.en: Our class has more girls than boys.
ex.ko: 우리 반에는 남자아이보다 여자아이가 더 많다.

easy: Used before a describing word to mean 'to a bigger degree'.

ex.en: This book is more exciting than the movie.
ex.ko: 이 책이 영화보다 더 재미있다.

easy: Not even a little bit.

ex.en: My cold is no better today.
ex.ko: 오늘 감기가 조금도 나아지지 않았다.

easy: Not any; zero of something.

ex.en: There are no cookies left in the jar.
ex.ko: 통에 쿠키가 하나도 남지 않았다.

easy: An answer that says you will not do something or do not agree.

ex.en: Mom's answer to the sleepover was a firm no.
ex.ko: 밤샘 파티에 대한 엄마의 대답은 단호한 '안 돼'였다.

easy: A group in the United Nations that helps countries keep people healthy.

ex.en: The WHO helps countries fight diseases.
ex.ko: 세계 보건 기구는 여러 나라가 질병과 싸우도록 돕는다.

easy: In or at that place, not here.

ex.en: Put your shoes over there by the door.
ex.ko: 신발은 저기 문 옆에 둬.

easy: About that point; on that thing someone said.

ex.en: You're right there, pizza is the best food.
ex.ko: 그 점은 네 말이 맞아, 피자가 최고의 음식이야.

easy: That place, not this place.

ex.en: From there, you can see the whole city.
ex.ko: 거기서는 도시 전체가 보인다.

easy: The number you get when you add one and one.

ex.en: Two is my lucky number.
ex.ko: 2는 나의 행운의 숫자다.

easy: A playing card with two marks on it.

ex.en: She played the two of hearts.
ex.ko: 그녀는 하트 2를 냈다.

easy: One more than one.

ex.en: I have two dogs and a cat.
ex.ko: 나는 강아지 두 마리와 고양이 한 마리가 있다.

easy: One or some, it does not matter which.

ex.en: You can pick any book you like.
ex.ko: 네가 좋아하는 아무 책이나 골라도 돼.

easy: Even a little bit.

ex.en: Is your tooth hurting any less?
ex.ko: 이가 조금이라도 덜 아프니?

easy: After that; next.

ex.en: We ate dinner, then we played a board game.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁을 먹고 나서 보드게임을 했다.

easy: Because of that; if so.

ex.en: If it rains, then we will play inside.
ex.ko: 비가 오면 그때는 안에서 놀 거야.

easy: At that time in the past.

ex.en: The then mayor opened our new school.
ex.ko: 당시 시장이 우리 새 학교의 문을 열었다.

easy: That time.

ex.en: I'll be home at six, so wait until then.
ex.ko: 6시에 집에 갈 테니 그때까지 기다려.

easy: The month after April and before June.

ex.en: We plant flowers in the garden in May.
ex.ko: 우리는 5월에 정원에 꽃을 심는다.

easy: The act of leaving a place.

ex.en: Her going made the whole class sad.
ex.ko: 그녀가 떠나서 반 전체가 슬퍼했다.

easy: The reason for something.

ex.en: The teacher explained the whys of the new rule.
ex.ko: 선생님이 새 규칙의 이유를 설명해 주셨다.

easy: In the time from one thing to the next.

ex.en: We had two games with a short rest between.
ex.ko: 우리는 두 경기를 했고 그 사이에 잠깐 쉬었다.

easy: In the space in the middle of two things.

ex.en: There were two houses with a big tree between.
ex.ko: 집 두 채가 있었고 그 사이에 큰 나무가 있었다.

easy: A polite word you put before a man's name.

ex.en: Mr. Kim is my math teacher.
ex.ko: 김 선생님은 우리 수학 선생님이다.

easy: Seeming a certain way when you see it.

ex.en: That's a funny-looking dog!
ex.ko: 저 강아지 참 웃기게 생겼다!

easy: Very close to, but not quite.

ex.en: I'm almost done with my homework.
ex.ko: 나는 숙제를 거의 다 했다.

easy: To the other side.

ex.en: We swam across to the other side of the pool.
ex.ko: 우리는 수영장 건너편까지 헤엄쳐 갔다.

easy: From one side to the other, going sideways.

ex.en: Cut the sandwich across to make two pieces.
ex.ko: 샌드위치를 가로로 잘라서 두 조각으로 만들어.

easy: The 16th letter of the English alphabet.

ex.en: Pig starts with the letter P.
ex.ko: Pig는 P로 시작한다.

easy: The 15th letter of the English alphabet.

ex.en: Owl starts with the letter O.
ex.ko: Owl은 O로 시작한다.

easy: Very grand and important-looking.

ex.en: The august old castle stood on top of the hill.
ex.ko: 위엄 있는 오래된 성이 언덕 꼭대기에 서 있었다.

easy: A person who has power over other people.

ex.en: In the story, the lord ruled the whole valley.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 그 군주는 골짜기 전체를 다스렸다.

easy: A man with a special high rank, like in England long ago.

ex.en: The lord lived in a huge castle with many servants.
ex.ko: 그 귀족은 하인이 많은 커다란 성에 살았다.

easy: A unit for measuring temperature. Water freezes at 32 of them.

ex.en: It was 90 °F at the beach today.
ex.ko: 오늘 해변은 화씨 90도였다.

easy: To leave someone or something out.

ex.en: Students who are sick will be excepted from the race.
ex.ko: 아픈 학생들은 달리기 경주에서 제외될 것이다.

easy: Not liking an idea or plan; being against it.

ex.en: Most kids in my class are anti weekend homework.
ex.ko: 우리 반 아이들 대부분은 주말 숙제에 반대한다.

easy: A building or place with special tools and workers for one kind of job.

ex.en: We stopped at a gas station to fill up the car.
ex.ko: 우리는 차에 기름을 넣으려고 주유소에 들렀다.

easy: To send someone to a certain place to stay and do a job.

ex.en: The coach stationed one player by each goal.
ex.ko: 코치는 골대마다 선수를 한 명씩 배치했다.

easy: The 10th letter of the English alphabet.

ex.en: Jellyfish starts with the letter J.
ex.ko: Jellyfish는 J로 시작한다.

easy: A person who is not important or famous.

ex.en: In the movie, a nobody becomes a famous hero.
ex.ko: 그 영화에서는 보잘것없는 사람이 유명한 영웅이 된다.

easy: Not smart; not thinking well.

ex.en: It was stupid of me to leave my lunch on the bus.
ex.ko: 버스에 점심을 두고 내린 건 내가 어리석었다.

easy: Having to do with the religion that follows Jesus.

ex.en: Christmas is a Christian holiday.
ex.ko: 크리스마스는 기독교의 명절이다.

easy: A person who believes in Jesus and follows his teachings.

ex.en: My aunt is a Christian and goes to church every Sunday.
ex.ko: 이모는 기독교인이라서 일요일마다 교회에 가신다.

easy: A person who helps run a company and makes big decisions.

ex.en: My mom is an executive at a toy company.
ex.ko: 엄마는 장난감 회사의 임원이시다.

easy: Having the job of carrying out laws or plans.

ex.en: The President leads the executive branch of the government.
ex.ko: 대통령은 정부의 행정부를 이끈다.

easy: The crime of killing a person on purpose.

ex.en: The detective in the story solved the murder.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 탐정이 그 살인 사건을 해결했다.

easy: Everything a person owns, like money, a house, and things.

ex.en: Grandpa left his estate to his three children.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 재산을 세 자녀에게 남기셨다.

easy: A large piece of land in the country, usually with a big house.

ex.en: The family's estate had horses, a pond, and a huge garden.
ex.ko: 그 가족의 사유지에는 말과 연못과 커다란 정원이 있었다.

easy: In the middle of something.

ex.en: We go to the beach in mid-July.
ex.ko: 우리는 7월 중순에 해변에 간다.

easy: A casual word for a man or boy, like 'buddy'.

ex.en: Dude, that skateboard trick was awesome!
ex.ko: 야, 그 스케이트보드 묘기 진짜 멋졌어!

easy: The man who leads the meetings of a group.

ex.en: The chairman tapped a small hammer to start the meeting.
ex.ko: 의장이 작은 망치를 두드려 회의를 시작했다.

easy: Not this one and not that one either.

ex.en: Neither shoe fits me anymore.
ex.ko: 두 신발 다 이제 나한테 안 맞는다.

easy: A man or boy.

ex.en: That fellow with the red hat is my uncle.
ex.ko: 빨간 모자를 쓴 저 남자가 우리 삼촌이다.

easy: A tool used for fighting or hunting, like a sword or a bow.

ex.en: The knight's only weapon was a long sword.
ex.ko: 그 기사의 유일한 무기는 긴 칼이었다.

easy: Something you use to win an argument or get what you want.

ex.en: Her sweet smile was her best weapon for getting extra dessert.
ex.ko: 귀여운 미소는 디저트를 더 얻어 내는 그녀의 최고 무기였다.

easy: Arranged neatly, following a rule or pattern.

ex.en: The books stood in ordered rows on the shelf.
ex.ko: 책들이 책장에 가지런히 줄지어 꽂혀 있었다.

easy: A drink for grown-ups made from grape juice; it has alcohol in it.

ex.en: Grandpa makes wine from the grapes in his yard.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 마당에서 기른 포도로 포도주를 만드신다.

easy: A dark red color, like red grape juice.

ex.en: She wore a wine dress to the party.
ex.ko: 그녀는 파티에 와인색 드레스를 입고 갔다.

easy: The side of something that is blocked from the wind.

ex.en: We set up our tent in the lee of a big rock.
ex.ko: 우리는 바람을 막아 주는 큰 바위 뒤쪽에 텐트를 쳤다.

easy: Using the huge power that comes from splitting tiny atoms, like in bombs.

ex.en: Many countries agreed to stop making nuclear weapons.
ex.ko: 많은 나라가 핵무기를 만들지 않기로 약속했다.

easy: Having to do with the tiny center of an atom.

ex.en: A nuclear power plant makes electricity for our city.
ex.ko: 원자력 발전소가 우리 도시에 전기를 만들어 준다.

easy: To keep bothering someone again and again.

ex.en: The little dog harried the cat all afternoon.
ex.ko: 작은 강아지가 오후 내내 고양이를 괴롭혔다.

easy: Changed by using a chemical or a special process.

ex.en: The wood was treated so it would not rot in the rain.
ex.ko: 그 나무는 비에 썩지 않도록 처리되었다.

easy: Given care by a doctor.

ex.en: A treated cut usually heals faster.
ex.ko: 치료받은 상처는 보통 더 빨리 낫는다.

easy: A bad habit or a weakness in the way someone acts.

ex.en: Eating too much candy is my only vice.
ex.ko: 사탕을 너무 많이 먹는 게 나의 유일한 나쁜 버릇이다.

easy: A drink for grown-ups made from grain; it has alcohol in it.

ex.en: Dad had a cold beer after mowing the lawn.
ex.ko: 아빠는 잔디를 깎고 나서 시원한 맥주를 드셨다.

easy: Belonging to the Republican Party, one of the two big political parties in the US.

ex.en: The Republican senator gave a speech at our school.
ex.ko: 공화당 상원 의원이 우리 학교에서 연설을 했다.

easy: Having to do with a government where the people vote for their leaders.

ex.en: The United States has a republican form of government.
ex.ko: 미국은 공화제 정부를 가지고 있다.

easy: A female friend.

ex.en: Mom went shopping with her girlfriends.
ex.ko: 엄마는 친구분들과 쇼핑을 가셨다.

easy: A girl or woman that someone loves and dates.

ex.en: My cousin brought his girlfriend to Thanksgiving dinner.
ex.ko: 사촌 오빠가 추수감사절 저녁에 여자 친구를 데려왔다.

easy: Having to do with Islam, the religion that follows the Quran.

ex.en: The Muslim holiday of Eid ends with a big family feast.
ex.ko: 이슬람교 명절인 이드는 가족들이 모여 큰 잔치를 하며 끝난다.

easy: A person who follows the religion of Islam.

ex.en: My classmate Amir is a Muslim and fasts during Ramadan.
ex.ko: 우리 반 친구 아미르는 무슬림이라서 라마단 기간에 금식한다.

easy: All the money a business takes in before paying its costs.

ex.en: Our lemonade stand's revenue was twenty dollars today.
ex.ko: 오늘 우리 레모네이드 가게의 매출은 20달러였다.

easy: Money a government gets from taxes.

ex.en: The city uses tax revenue to build new parks.
ex.ko: 시는 세금으로 걷은 돈으로 새 공원을 짓는다.

easy: The kind of medicine where doctors fix the body by opening it up.

ex.en: Dr. Lee teaches surgery at a big hospital.
ex.ko: 이 박사님은 큰 병원에서 외과를 가르치신다.

easy: Holding electricity, either plus or minus.

ex.en: Rubbing a balloon makes it charged, so it sticks to the wall.
ex.ko: 풍선을 문지르면 전기를 띠어서 벽에 달라붙는다.

easy: Full of strong feelings.

ex.en: The gym was charged with excitement before the big game.
ex.ko: 큰 경기를 앞두고 체육관은 흥분으로 가득 찼다.

easy: A group of countries in Europe that work and trade together.

ex.en: France and Germany are both part of the EU.
ex.ko: 프랑스와 독일은 둘 다 유럽 연합에 속해 있다.
